rejected: R24SY-3 SYN-DN (synthetic-pretrained DaughterNet): refuted. It is never a final by design (0 private value). Its gates do not predict value (v2 beat v1 on AUC and was worse for insertion). The generator is geometry-only, external evidence is 0/4, and it would cost 2-2.5 GPU-h plus a W4 slot. Post-deadline study only. R24SY-6 synthetic secondary/detector fine-tune and synthetic-derived insertion geometry: ruled out (2.1 h/epoch; public reports -0.004..-0.009; the geometry would be circular). R24-PP-3 exp79b coordinject ALPHA 1.0: refuted. It is the worst point of a smooth lab dose curve (every alpha-1 variant negative); out of sample the best alpha shifts DOWN; CI files are info-only for the finals; the ledger would misfile it; no registered slot kind fits it. R24-PP-6 ILP-fork restore: refuted as a build. It targets the same niche as the insertion, its precision is at break-even (0.149-0.19 vs 0.161), it has no replay bed, and nobody disclosed it. R24-PP-4 amanatar second-daughter repair: it is I-047 with a wider gate (1 TP / 31 FP), default OFF, and nothing public scores above 0.953. Do not port. R24-PP-5 the remaining amanatar / Lineage Forge / Geometric Fusion / 035 / newwang12 stages: closed families with our own LB reads, or default-OFF stages with no disclosed ON value. R24S-7 RA98 (READMIT 0.98, exp87f/g/h): refuted. It is the leaf-prune channel in disguise (readmits are 95% of lp30 removals; P36 - #35 = 0; leaf prune on x138 is closed). 0.98 was not disclosed, and a '-' at 0.94 does not imply '+' at 0.98. Not built, no row. R24S-9 'V_pub + its one-lever parent' finals line: refuted. mc23 already contains P7/P14, which lose 0.05-0.16 bronze in all 8 scenarios. #37 stays the partner per v2 (9). R24S-11 as written: the unconditional READMIT <= 0.90 ban is replaced by the conditional RA90 (R24-A2/A6). Its other closures stand: ILP arms other than 0.4, exp85b/85c as single rungs, READMIT_RADIUS/gapfill, cap 10/16, fc2 on cap 8, thr/DC/tau/N1. R24-RC-C value claims: exp85b is not promoted to W2b on the strength of its +3 safe divisions (3 marginal forks <= ~+0.0008; most likely reads 0.956), and ILP 0.4 alone is not carried into W4 after R0/R-. Only the correction line is kept, and exp85b is a Row-4 fallback only. R24S-2 R- -> exp85b (the skeptic's fix): not adopted, for the same reason. R- goes to exp81, the one never-read lever that has a pre-registered slot. PC24-02's 'exp85a as a BASE' framing: replaced by 'K is a lever on the cap-family BASE' (R24S-3 lookup). Same effect, fewer rule changes. PC24-03's names exp83h/exp82d: replaced by exp87a (the same file); exp82d is not needed (exp81 is not read under R+). R24-NF 'code ILP and READMIT as separate levers': for slots, K stays one bundled lever (RC-C skeptic); the attribution caveat is logged only.
